blueprint_concepts: Scalar and vector products of four vectors
english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$, $\overrightarrow{c}$, $\overrightarrow{d}$ be vectors such that $|\overrightarrow{c}|=1$, $|\overrightarrow{d}|=2$, $\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=1$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=2$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=-\dfrac{1}{2}$, $\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=1$ and $\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=2$. Let $\overrightarrow{p}=\overrightarrow{a}\times\left(\overrightarrow{b}\times\left(\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d}\right)\right)$. Then the value of $\overrightarrow{p}\cdot\left(\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d}\right)$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$, $\overrightarrow{c}$, $\overrightarrow{d}$ ऐसे सदिश हैं कि $|\overrightarrow{c}|=1$, $|\overrightarrow{d}|=2$, $\overrightarrow{c}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=1$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=2$, $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=-\dfrac{1}{2}$, $\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}=1$ तथा $\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{d}=2$ है। माना कि $\overrightarrow{p}=\overrightarrow{a}\times\left(\overrightarrow{b}\times\left(\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d}\right)\right)$ है। तब $\overrightarrow{p}\cdot\left(\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d}\right)$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: First expand the inner triple product: $\overrightarrow{b}\times(\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d})=(\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{d})\overrightarrow{c}-(\overrightarrow{b}\cdot\overrightarrow{c})\overrightarrow{d}=2\overrightarrow{c}-\overrightarrow{d}$.

Each term is a scalar product of four vectors: $(\overrightarrow{x}\times\overrightarrow{y})\cdot(\overrightarrow{u}\times\overrightarrow{v})=(\overrightarrow{x}\cdot\overrightarrow{u})(\overrightarrow{y}\cdot\overrightarrow{v})-(\overrightarrow{x}\cdot\overrightarrow{v})(\overrightarrow{y}\cdot\overrightarrow{u})$.

The data are consistent: $|\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d}|^2=1\cdot4-1=3\neq 0$, and $\overrightarrow{a}$, $\overrightarrow{b}$ can be chosen with the given dot products with $\overrightarrow{c}$, $\overrightarrow{d}$ (any component along $\overrightarrow{c}\times\overrightarrow{d}$ is free and does not affect the answer).
originality_note: New: a triply nested cross product dotted with c x d, evaluated from dot-product data only; one triple-product expansion reduces it to two four-vector scalar products whose values need |c|, |d| and c.d (way 5). Closest known: evaluating (a x b).(c x d) from given dot products, or simplifying a x (b x (c x d)). Different because: the nesting must be opened from the inside, and the answer exists only because the free components cancel.

concept_use.Application of Vector triple product: b x (c x d) = (b.d) c - (b.c) d = 2c - d, so p = 2(a x c) - (a x d).
concept_use.Scalar and vector products of four vecto: (a x c).(c x d) and (a x d).(c x d) evaluated by (x x y).(u x v) = (x.u)(y.v) - (x.v)(y.u).

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and object is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked with explicit vectors (several choices of the free components) that the answer is always -3.5. Changed: No change.
key_step: Opening the nested product from the inside, then two four-vector scalar products with the right pairing of dots.
justification: Two vector-algebra identities chained, with sign and pairing traps in the four-vector products and a numerical answer. Like 2021-P1-Q19 (L3): abstract data with dot products leading to a triple-product value.
